titulo_ja: できる と すき (2)
titulo_es: To be able to do and like to do

うたえます.consejo: It is the form of power of the city.

得意.es: hábil; que se le da bien
得意.en: He is able to do well; he is good.

苦手.es: que se le da mal; no gustar
苦手.en: that he is given evil; not to like

texto: Another way to say you can do something, more formal: verb in dictionary + **こと が できます**: **にほんご を はなす こと が できます** (I can speak Japanese).
**こと** means «thing, done» and here it serves to convert the verb into name.
To say what you like to do, I verb in dictionary + **の が すき です**: **うた を うたう の が すき です** (I like to sing).
With **の** you turn the verb into name and give **が** the subject function.

bloques.titulo: In this case, the Commission is not in a position to take the necessary measures to ensure that the measures are implemented in the context of the internal market.
texto: To say that you do well, use the same mold with **じょうず**: **りょうり が じょうず です** (I'm good at cooking).
Eye: **じょうず** is an adjective in -na: **じょうず です** is said, not **じょうずい**.
